description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Myr tokens, adding {2}{B}.
Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers three times, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding one mana of any color.
Demon of Dark Schemes triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Activate Demon of Dark Schemes by paying {2}{B} and {E}{E}{E}{E}, putting Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
